company.description:
applixya™ is a high-end provider of vertically-focused enterprise mobile technology solutions and platforms that unleash the potential its clients' organization and enable business transformation. applixya™'s vertical focus includes Government/Public Sector and Education services Sector with a formidable track record in these sectors as well as intellectual property and reusable frameworks.

At applixya™, they create innovation through intellectual property and passion. As a high-end player specializing in enterprise platforms and applications, applixya™ envisions, architects and delivers strategic and mission critical mobile applications to support their customers in their business transformation initiatives. Their strength in architecting large and complex applications is valuable to customers trying to create agile business environments. Their quality of work and the impact it creates is their self-governing benchmark.
